Trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth has collapsed by -103% and profit growth has plunged by -243% [E13, E14]. This deterioration is compounded by a dismal return profile, featuring a negative ROCE of -10.2% and a negative ROE of -5.8%, alongside multi-year median returns that have steadily declined toward zero or negative territory [E11, E12, E19, E20, E21]. Furthermore, cash generation is non-existent, highlighted by negative operating cash flow of Rs -0.25 Cr and negative free cash flow of Rs -0.47 Cr in Mar 2020, resulting in a crippled cash conversion ratio of 0.06x [E22, E23, E24]. Despite this fundamental decay, the stock trades at an inflated P/E of 46.95x and an EV/EBITDA of 53.57x, both of which severely disconnect from their respective sector benchmarks of 17.97x and 12.98x [E5, E10]. Compounding these operational risks, working capital days have ballooned from 6,676 days to an extraordinary 18,907 days, and historical share price performance shows consistent losses over 1-year, 3-year, and 5-year horizons [E16, E17, E18, E37].
